Messages.Author: Bloodartist
Messages.Body:
> hardyrange wrote:
> www.vekn.net/rulebook/appendix-imbued-rules
>
Sure you can play brainwash on an uncontrolled imbued, as mentioned in the link, but the real question is: Does it actually prevent transfers to and from the imbued, since the card says "to and from THAT VAMPIRE". Playing the card can't really be prevented since the uncontrolled card is of unknown type to the person playing brainwash. Imbued player knows that the uncontrolled card is an imbued; He sees brainwash. Can he transfer or not?

I'd also like to point out a disparity in text between the card rulings card list, and the actual ruling (edit: and secret library entry). One says vampire, the other says minion.

Smoking craters tell no tales.
—Tex talks Battletech

I had not checked this... teaches me to always follow the old rule to require card text when someone asks a rule question about a card.

> Name: Brainwash
> [Jyhad:C, VTES:C, CE:U]
> Cardtype: Master
> Master.
> Put this card on an uncontrolled minion in your prey's uncontrolled region. This card remains in play. No transfers can be used to move blood to or from that card. Any minion may burn this card as a +1 stealth  action.
> Artist: Edward Beard, Jr.
>
As this is the current official card text, the question is answered...
